newsletter.title: Unsubscribe from the newsletter
newsletter.info: Confirm to stop receiving the newsletter.
newsletter.success: Done: you will no longer receive the newsletter. You can subscribe again at any time in your account settings.

weekly.info: Confirm to stop receiving the weekly reminder. You can still fill in the questionnaire whenever you like.
